status: Supersedes the default browse-mode inference in editor-review-d468.json; original review remains historical.

source_evidence.finding: The constructor initializes editing=false and moves the document cursor to its start.
Rendering resolves the configured entry policy; a newly focused, non-inert, writable editor begins editing when that policy is Immediate.
Before the first focus draw, key handling also begins editing for Immediate entry and then processes the same input.
The NewQuery action creates an empty query and focuses its primary editor.

corrected_contract: Under the frozen default policy, Ctrl+T followed by primary-editor focus immediately enters editing. Requiring an additional Enter changes the baseline flow. A constructor flag alone does not establish the visible or interactive state.
required_implementation: Keep text and editing mechanics in the shared CodeEditor state. Implement the configurable focus-entry transition in update or the existing prepared focus lifecycle, with no domain effects or state mutation during measurement/drawing. Immediate must remain the baseline default; an explicit browse-entry option may remain available. Do not put unconditional begin_edit calls into application constructors as a substitute.
required_regressions: New empty query with default policy accepts the first typed character without an extra Enter.
New preloaded query enters editing on focus with the frozen cursor placement.
An explicit browse-entry configuration still requires its documented edit command.
Blur, refocus, completion popup, modal coverage and resize preserve the documented entry and caret behavior.
limits: This is an independent source diagnosis, not a new paired CLI capture or product-parity acceptance.
